project: Machine Learning-Based Email Spam and Phishing Detection System

email_subsystem.preprocessing_pipeline: Variant C (HTML structure cleaning, style/script stripping, entity unescaping, block spacing, controlled opt-out boilerplate consolidation)

training_dataset.source: Unified Multi-Corpus Augmented (Enron + SpamAssassin + Ling-Spam + CEAS-08 + TREC-07 + TREC-06)

validation_metrics.evaluation_purpose: Used strictly for hyperparameter validation and decision threshold tuning

test_metrics.evaluation_purpose: Independent blind evaluation on held-out test split (untouched during training and threshold tuning)

hard_ham_diagnostic_metrics.evaluation_purpose: Diagnostic tracking of commercial marketing newsletter and e-zine false positive regression
hard_ham_diagnostic_metrics.disclosure: The 250 Hard Ham samples were analyzed in Phase 4 and Phase 5 and are NOT an untouched blind holdout. These numbers reflect progress on known historical false positive failure modes.

synthetic_test_metrics.evaluation_purpose: Adversarial behavioral evaluation across 18 synthetic edge-case emails
synthetic_test_metrics.disclosure: Synthetic emails are curated functional unit tests and are NOT statistically representative of real-world corporate or consumer traffic volume.

mismatches.reason: Promotional discount text ('50% off', 'flash sale') without corporate branding triggers commercial spam token weights.

url_subsystem.disclosure: URL classifier performance is bounded by lexical features and PhiUSIIL dataset characteristics. Canonical root and subdomain parsing prevent overfitting to specific apex domains.

known_limitations: Spam classification is not identical to dedicated phishing intent detection: highly conversational spear-phishing without bulk keywords relies on embedded hyperlink extraction.
Hard-ham evaluation is no longer an untouched holdout and must be reported solely as a diagnostic measure.
Synthetic email suite tests specific functional boundaries (invoices, newsletters, lures) but cannot substitute for live production email stream monitoring.
Lexical URL analysis cannot detect malicious content hosted on hijacked legitimate infrastructure or zero-day compromised subdomains.
